name: Meals on Wheels Diablo Region
description: Meals on Wheels Diablo Region serves all of Contra Costa County (West, Central, and East), delivering meals with safety checks to homebound seniors and offering grocery delivery, senior lunch cafés, and friendly visitor programs.
fullDescription: Meals on Wheels Diablo Region serves all of Contra Costa County (West, Central, and East), delivering meals with safety checks to homebound seniors and offering grocery delivery, senior lunch cafés, and friendly visitor programs.
whatTheyOffer:
- Home-delivered meals with a safety check from the driver
- Grocery Bag Program - groceries and fresh produce delivered twice a month to low-income homebound seniors 55+ (with Food Bank of Contra Costa and Solano)
- Senior Cafés - free or low-cost lunches at senior centers in Bay Point, Brentwood, Concord, Pittsburg, Rodeo, and more (reservations required)
- Friendly Visitors and other supportive programs
- Voluntary contributions accepted for meals
howToGetIt: Home-delivered meals are for seniors 60+ who are homebound, unable to drive to get food, and don't have a caregiver who prepares their meals. Call 925-937-8311, email info@mowdr.org, or fill out the online Meals Inquiry Form. For the Grocery Bag Program, call 925-448-3694.
keywords: Meals on Wheels, Diablo Region, Contra Costa, home delivered meals, senior meals, homebound, wellness check, grocery bag, senior cafe, senior lunch
